statement_summary: Security and PCI Lead designated in writing
Yearly risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
Written PCI DSS scope before signing any SAQ; P2PE devices only
Service provider list, written agreements, yearly AOC check
Approval and change log for online store scripts and custom code; nothing on checkout
Yearly independent assessment
Records kept at least 3 years
Yearly policy review; written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Personal accounts and POS codes; no shared codes
Role-based least privilege; payout changes by the Owner only; content-only role for the freelancer
MFA for every login above cashier, every mailbox, and MSP administrator logins
Last-day checklist completed by the last day
Monthly comparison of accounts with the payroll roster and provider list
Named MSP, provider, and freelancer accounts with MFA; yearly technician list
Password length and manager; POS codes not shared; Wi-Fi password changed yearly and on departures
Customer look-ups only to serve the customer
Never write down or send card numbers or security codes
No customer data in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock the PC; never share codes or approve unexpected MFA prompts
Training at hire and yearly (tampering, phishing)
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
E-commerce skimming runbook kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Notify the payment provider within 24 hours of suspecting a card compromise
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged under contract
Breach determination dated; notices on time; no-notice decisions documented
Preserve evidence before changing pages or wiping devices
Extortion payment only with approvals and an OFAC check
Vendor incident reports logged; 10-day notice term in contracts
Yearly tabletop exercise with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Card data never kept; virtual terminal off; truncated paper shredded after 90 days
Card numbers received by email deleted; auto-reply warning
Restricted data only in approved systems; no full customer exports
Inventory of devices, SaaS, scripts, and data locations
Terminal list, daily inspections, identity check before service; P2PE devices only
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Approved AI tools only
New tools and sharing approved, under agreement, and reflected in the privacy notice
Office PC backup restore tested twice a year; monthly platform export
Wipe or reset devices; shred paper; disposal records
